name: Useless And Constant info
description: Customizable real-time HUD for Geometry Dash. Shows FPS, CPS, accuracy, level info, time, session, mod menus and more. Open settings from the HUD button next to the Daily Chest.
changelog:
## v5.2.0

**Fixes:**
- Settings window rebuilt on `geode::Popup` and resized to fit the screen; touches no longer pass through
- Settings are applied and saved immediately; saving can no longer overwrite pending changes
- Drag-to-reposition keeps the selected corner and now persists offsets
- Real color picker (`ColorPickPopup`)
- CPS counts jumps again; accuracy is noclip-aware; deaths are no longer double counted
- Session timer no longer resets on focus loss; play time is flushed every 60 s
- Mod menu detection is local-only (no network, no uninstalled mods)
- HUD button is placed next to the Daily Chest; hide on enter/leave level fixed
- Level/user names containing braces or separators no longer break the label

## v5.1.0

**Performance:**
- Static cache (dirty flags) for GD version, Geode version, OS, mod count — computed once, never recalculated
- All string building uses `fmt::format` instead of `std::stringstream`
- `InfoOverlay::applyVisuals` only recreates label node when font actually changes
- Z-Order raised to 999999 (above all GD layers)
- Dynamic resolution detection: `updatePosition()` auto-called when window size changes

**New Tags:**
- `{cps}` — Clicks Per Second (rolling 1-second window via `PlayLayer::pushButton` hook)
- `{accuracy}` — Noclip accuracy as frames_alive/frames_total %. Optional: only show with Noclip active
- `{deaths}` — Session deaths or total attempts
- `{session_total}` — Persistent total play time across sessions (saved with `setSavedValue`)

**UI:**
- Real `ColorPickPopup` for text and background colors
- Preset buttons: Minimalist, Standard, Developer
- Live preview label in Builder tab updates as you add tags
- Drag-to-reposition: enable drag mode in General tab, drag overlay to desired position
- Tab styles update to show active tab

**Polish:**
- Separator cleanup uses `std::regex` — handles any separator string, not just ` | `
- Month names in English (suitable for Geode Index global release)
- Play time flushed to disk on `applicationWillResignActive`
- CPS timestamps cleared on level entry

## v5.0.0
- Multi-file architecture, custom UI, OverlayManager, all screen tracking

## v4.0.0 — v1.0.0
- See GitHub for full history
